state:
Subject: FW: Possible food safety issue at Riverside branch

From: Mark Chen <m.chen@foodco.com>
To: ops-team@foodco.com

Hi team,

Forwarding this from a customer who visited the Riverside branch yesterday evening. Please take a look and advise.

Mark

---

From: customer.feedback@foodco.com
To: m.chen@foodco.com

We received this via the website feedback form:

"I ate at your Riverside location around 7pm last night. I ordered the grilled chicken salad. The lettuce looked a little brown on the edges, but I thought it was just the darker leaves. The chicken was warm and seemed fine. About 2 hours later I started feeling nauseous and had stomach cramps. I vomited once. I'm feeling better now, but I want to report it. Also, I noticed a worker at the salad station wasn't wearing gloves when they put croutons on my salad. I'm not sure if that's related. I'd like someone to look into it."

Regards,

Customer Service Team

---

From: mark.chen@foodco.com
To: ops-team@foodco.com

Can someone from the ops team respond to this? We haven't had any other complaints from that branch recently. The branch manager says the salad prep area was cleaned at closing last night and all ingredients were within use-by dates. But we don't have a record of the employee's glove use for that shift.

Thanks,

Mark
question: Based on the reported symptoms and observations, how likely is it that this incident requires escalation to the regional food safety manager?
